key_notes: Key 1 (t=3.8s): Initial archival pose of aircraft-carrier; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.

Key 3 (t=6.16s): Peak dynamic extension of aircraft-carrier over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=7.4s): Follow-through and settle of aircraft-carrier with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of aircraft-carrier (3.8s..7.4s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
